description: This file defines custom Cypress commands for mocking API responses, login handling, and seeding authentication in end-to-end tests for a dashboard web application.

methods.name: mockApi
methods.description: Sets up intercepts for various API endpoints to simulate backend behavior for login, user management, report management, and chart data retrieval.

methods.name: loginUI
methods.description: Automates login process through the UI by filling form fields and clicking the sign in button.

methods.name: seedAuth
methods.description: Directly stores a fake JWT token in localStorage to simulate an authenticated session without UI interaction.
